preconditions.description: The number of nodes in the tree is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
The number of edges in the tree is between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= edge[0] <= N and 1 <= edge[1] <= N for edge in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two nodes within the valid range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(edge[0] != edge[1] for edge in edges)
preconditions.description: No self-loops are present in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(edge[0] not in edges[edge[1]] and edge[1] not in edges[edge[0]] for edge in edges)
preconditions.description: The graph is a tree, meaning it is connected and has no cycles.

postconditions.expression: return_value == min(selected_nodes for selected_nodes in range(1, N+1) if lights_up_all_edges(N, edges, selected_nodes))
postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of nodes required to light up all edges in the tree.
